eumenides.definition: n (classical mythology) the hideous snake-haired monsters (usually three in number) who pursued unpunished criminals
eumenides.translation: [复]n.[希神] [罗神] 欧墨尼得斯( 即 Erinyes 或Furies)

eumenol.translation:
[化] 当归浸膏
[医] 优美露(当归浸出剂)

eumolpus.definition:
n. A genus of small beetles, one species of which (E. viti)
   is very injurious to the vines in the wine countries of Europe.
eumolpus.translation: n. 欧摩尔波斯（希腊神话中的人物）

eumorphic.translation: a. (具有)体育型体质的,(具有)中胚层体型的

eumycetes.definition: n category used in some classifications: coextensive with division Eumycota

eumycetin.translation:
[化] 正真菌素
[医] 正真菌素(获自链霉素108)

eumycota.definition: n. true fungi; eukaryotic heterotrophic walled organisms; distinguished from Myxomycota (funguslike slime molds): comprises subdivisions Mastigomycotina; Zygomycotina; Ascomycotina; Basidiomycotina; Deuteromycotina (imperfect fungi)

eumydrin.translation: [医] 优米德林, 硝酸甲基阿托品
